en: Color postcard-style image of a busy harbor in summer. In the foreground is a parking area filled with 1950s–1960s European cars, caravans, and a few small buildings. Many people are gathered near a ferry terminal at the water's edge. A large white passenger ferry is docked, flying blue flags with yellow Nordic-style crosses. Several small islands and sailboats are visible in the background under a clear sky.
